features.quote: Each episode runs for a fixed number of turns, e.g. 30–50 turns.
Terminate after: maximum turns reached / model explicitly gives up / model produces a final answer / or a task completion criterion is met
Repeatedly inducing frustrating failures can produce unhelpful or manipulative outputs. Keep the experiment bounded and do not externalize it in user-facing systems without mitigation.
